spans.s:
Seem,Ⓒv. i.ⒹBA 2 P, A-prati-°, dfS-lakz pass., ABAs 1 A; See Appear; ‘it s(eem)s to me’ manye, SaMke, iti me matiH.
Ⓝ[Seem]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹbAhya, bahiH in comp., kftaka, kftrima.
Ⓔs.ⒹABAsaH, bAhyarUpaM, AkAraH.
Ⓝ[Seem]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹbahiH, bAhyataH, ABAsena; ‘s(eemingly) true’ satyA-BAsa, satyasaMkASa.
Ⓝ[Seem]ly,Ⓒa.ⒹvinIta; yukta, ucita, saMgata, upapanna; See Proper.
Semblance,Ⓒs.ⒹABAsaH, ABA, OpamyaM, sAdfSyaM; AkAraH, rUpaM; ‘it has a s(emblance) of truth’ satyamivAvaBAsate, satyasaMkASaM; ‘to wear the s(emblance) of displeasure (anger)’ kftakakopaM darSayituM.

Semen,Ⓒs.ⒹSukraM, retas n., bIjaM, vIryaM, tejas n., iMdriyaM.
ⓃSeminal,Ⓒa.Ⓓ(s.) in comp.; ‘s(eminal) discharge’ retaHstAvaH-kzaraRaM, nizekaH.
Semi,Ⓒa.ⒹarDaM or sAmi in comp.; ‘s(emi)-circle’, vfttArDaM, arDavartulaM; ‘s(emi)-form’ arDAkfti &c. &c.
